items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: I was, I was the best man for their wedding.

ctx.x: Fantastic. Who was in the band then?

There was only four of us in there. It was Billy, when we first started it was Burtz. Burtz Stevenson was playing trumpet. It was Burtz, myself, Billy, and uh, a fella by the name of McGee, playing drum. Dede, he was working further down on Decatur Street, between St. Philip and uh, Dumaine, right close to where there's Vincent. The Lucas have the hardware. And then they, they fell in love with one another. And they got married. I was, I was the best man for their wedding. And that's where Billy got, uh, boys…
He came by and heard you there? Yes.
